defects.description: Code token altered: the required back‑ticked token `role_agent_config` is replaced with a Russian variant "Роль_agent_config".
Glossary term "Role Status" is not rendered as the required "Статус роли"; the translation uses "статусы Роль" which is incorrect.
Incorrect case for the term "Phase"; should be "по Фазе".
Table rows contain wrong scope translations and duplicate/incorrect entries; the source row "top_p | 0.9 | analytical-task reviews" is rendered as "top_p | 0.9 | аналитическая-Задача обзоры".
Malformed markdown table delimiter line breaks the table format.
The phrase "базовый шаблон запроса Роль" incorrectly appends the term "Роль" after the template description; the term should not be present here.
